results.title: Superchat Alternative: When Switching Pays Off for Your Shop
results.content:
Superchat is a good tool. It is just built for car dealerships, doctors' offices and driving schools as much as it is for your D2C shop. That is exactly where it gets expensive: abandoned cart flows, Klaviyo sync, and the question of what a campaign actually earned.

Here is the maths: which alternative to Superchat fits which case, what it costs, and when you are better off staying put. Written for brands selling into Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

## Is there an alternative to Superchat?

Yes. For shops in the DACH region, charles, hellomateo, ChatWerk and Chatarmin are the most relevant alternatives to Superchat, alongside email tools with a WhatsApp add-on such as Klaviyo or Brevo. [...] Book a demo. We will show you your concrete setup with your shop data in 30 minutes. If Superchat is the better choice for you, we will say so on the call.

## Frequently asked questions about Superchat alternatives

### Is there an alternative to Superchat?

Yes. For DACH shops, charles, hellomateo, ChatWerk, Lime Connect and Chatarmin are the most relevant alternatives to Superchat, alongside email tools with a WhatsApp add-on such as Klaviyo and Brevo.

### How much does Superchat cost?

Free €0, Basic €89, Professional €149, Advanced €299 per month, cheaper on annual billing; enterprise on request. Add-ons such as analytics (€29), integrations (€49) and newsletter reach (€49) come on top, as do the Meta fees (pricing page, as of 29 July 2026). [...] Superchat is a multichannel generalist: seven channels in one inbox, review management, 4.7 out of 5 stars across 341 OMR reviews and three Leader badges for Q3/26. Strong for local service businesses and support teams.
 €149 turns into €276 fast: the Professional plan plus analytics, integrations and newsletter reach add up before Meta fees even enter the picture.
 Included WhatsApp newsletter reach is 100 contacts on every paid plan, more only via add-on or sales; the minimum contract term is 12 months.
 Shopify is documented via Zapier or Make, so you build abandoned cart as a Zap; automatic revenue attribution per campaign appears in neither the analytics nor the campaigns documentation.
